summary: Glass Bottom Games' bird-sized skateboarding game, built around tiny-object trick parks, character customization, and a whimsical take on the Tony Hawk-style trick format.

entries.title: Skatebird

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows at the highest stable settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: Skatebird released for Linux, macOS, Windows, Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and Amazon Luna in September 2021, with PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 versions following in 2023. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible native route for the small-scale skateboarding game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings; use Switch for portable play, PS5/Xbox as console alternatives, or Luna only where cloud access remains available.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or complete edition; PlayStation versions are later ports.
